dataset_note: The historical 1200-case S9 fixture predates planning_horizon_years. For reproducibility only, the S9 analysis materialises an explicit 1.0-year horizon in an in-memory copy before calling the strict S10 analyzer. No production fallback exists.

method.score_weight_rule: Perturb the target score weight and proportionally renormalize the other weights in the same group so the group still sums to 1.
